title: Content-Security-Policy without form-action
description: The Content-Security-Policy header does not restrict form-action. This directive has no default-src fallback in CSP, so the restriction must be stated on its own to take effect.
remediation: Add form-action to the policy with a restrictive source list (form-action 'self').
limitation: Header check: it also fires when no Content-Security-Policy header is sent. DPK-DAST-002 reports that case. The check cannot see a policy delivered by a meta element.
